content: LinkedIn SEO: headline carries most recruiter-search weight (role + specialization + keywords, more than just job title); About is second-highest weighted, story structure who-you-help/outcomes/how/CTA; skills = SEO, use all 50 slots, pin top 3 to target role; keyword weight order headline > about > current experience > skills; Open to Work recruiter-only mode; location settings matter for recruiter filters.
